answer: Every new identity must trace a provenance thread back to an existing trusted peer, and only agents whose score passes a summit threshold gain voting weight. Sybil resistance can be built by requiring each agent to stake a bonded deposit and maintain a slow-moving reputation score that only rises after sustained verified work, like a glacier advancing. Fake identities cost real stake and months of effort, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0252 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
